Word timings

Complete, clean letter sequences ranked by mean letter gap. Punctuation and spaces separate sequences.

Measurement details

Space submits the current word. Extra letters stay attached to it. Accuracy counts substitutions, extra keystrokes and skipped letters as misses, even if you go back to correct them. Backspace reopens the previous entry. WPM counts correct characters, including spaces and punctuation, in groups of five per active minute.

Pair and zone times are medians of adjacent correct letters. Case is normalized for grouping. Errors, edits, punctuation, spaces and focus changes break a pair. Each key needs three samples for a heatmap color. The side comparison needs eight samples on each side. Finger use is self-observed.

Reading a rare word, reaching for Shift and decoding a random string all affect speed. Compare runs with the same settings.
